analysis.title: Jones Lang LaSalle Inc. (JLL): 3Q26 First Take: Strong beat and raise quarter, focus turns to '27
key_insights: JLL reported 3Q26 Adj. EPS of $6.76 and Adj. EBITDA of $460.2mn. Adj. EPS was +11% above GSe ($6.08) and +10% above Visible Alpha consensus ($6.12). Adj. EBITDA was +11% above GSe ($415.5mn) and +9% above consensus ($423.2mn).
The beat came mainly from the leasing advisory and capital markets segments, partly offset by lower investment management revenues.
Leasing advisory revenue grew +27% YoY vs GSe +18%, driven by office, industrial and data center demand. Average deal size rose, lifting US growth. Segment margin was 21.0% vs GSe 20.1%.

Capital markets revenue grew +20% YoY vs GSe +12.2%, with broad growth across geographies and sectors led by investment sales, debt and equity advisory. The US and Japan led. Segment margin was 17.8% vs GSe 16.0%.

Real estate management services grew +9% YoY vs GSe +8.4%, on workplace management client wins and mandate expansions and project management growth led by the US and India. Softness in Australia and parts of Europe partly offset it.
Investment management revenue fell -9% YoY vs GSe +1.4%, on lower incentive and transaction fees.
Management intends to execute a $500mn accelerated share repurchase, bringing FY repurchases to about $1bn.

FY26 Adj. EPS guidance was raised to $25.20-$26.30 (midpoint $25.75) from $24.60-$25.90 (midpoint $25.25), above GSe $24.70 and consensus $24.82. This implies 4Q26 EPS of $10.30 vs GSe $9.94 and consensus $10.06.
FY26 leasing advisory revenue guide improved to high teens growth from mid to high teens, vs GSe +17%. This implies roughly +5% to +10% YoY in 4Q26.

Capital markets guidance was maintained at mid-teens revenue growth vs GSe +11.5%, implying +2% to +7% YoY in 4Q26. Real estate management guidance was maintained at mid to high single digit growth vs GSe +8.7%. Investment management guidance was maintained at low single digit advisory fee growth.
GS expects JLL shares to outperform on Wednesday 10/28 on the results and higher guidance, but says performance will likely depend on 2027 outlook commentary.

market_movers.rationale: Strong 3Q26 beat and raised FY26 EPS guidance driven by leasing and capital markets. The $447 target is based on 17.1x EPS and 10.6x EV/EBITDA on Q5-Q8 estimates, 49.0% above the $299.93 close.

earnings_insights: JLL 3Q26 Adj. EPS reported $6.76 vs GSe $6.08 and Visible Alpha consensus $6.12, a beat of +11.2% vs GSe and +10.4% vs consensus. Adj. EPS grew +50.2% YoY.
JLL 3Q26 Adj. EBITDA reported $460.2mn vs GSe $415.5mn and consensus $423.2mn (+10.8% and +8.7%). YoY growth was +32.5%. Adj. EBITDA margin was 17.7% vs GSe 16.6% and consensus 17.0%.
Total revenue grew +11.8% YoY reported vs GSe +9.7% and consensus +10.1%.
FY26 Adj. EPS guidance range $25.20-$26.30, midpoint $25.75, vs GSe $24.70 and consensus $24.82. Implied 4Q26 EPS is $10.30 vs GSe $9.94 and consensus $10.06.
GS estimates FFOPS of $24.70 for 12/26E, $26.77 for 12/27E and $30.56 for 12/28E, vs $18.81 in 12/25.
